TABLE.NAME: quizquest
TABLE.COMMENT: Main table for Quiz Quest activity instances

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course this activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity name

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description shown on course page

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field

FIELD.NAME: questioncategoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question bank category to draw questions from, stored as categoryid,contextid

FIELD.NAME: steps
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of correct answers required to complete

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum grade points awarded on completion

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum attempts allowed; -1 means unlimited

FIELD.NAME: showprogress
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to show step progress bar to student

FIELD.NAME: allowstudentreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether students can review their own past attempts

FIELD.NAME: partialscoreonquit
FIELD.COMMENT: Award partial score proportional to progress when student quits

FIELD.NAME: wrongpenalty
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether a wrong answer subtracts a step from the tally

FIELD.NAME: quizquest
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to quizquest table

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: inprogress, completed, abandoned

FIELD.NAME: stepstally
FIELD.COMMENT: Running tally of steps towards completion

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when attempt was completed

FIELD.NAME: ispreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this attempt was made by a teacher/manager previewing the activity

TABLE.NAME: quizquest_responses
TABLE.COMMENT: Individual question turns within an attempt

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to quizquest_attempts

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question bank question that was asked; also used to prefer unseen questions

FIELD.NAME: response
FIELD.COMMENT: The student's response: chosen answer label or typed short answer; null while unanswered

FIELD.NAME: iscorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the response was judged correct; null while unanswered

FIELD.NAME: stepchange
FIELD.COMMENT: Step delta applied by this response
